To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a multibeam CO 2 laser excited by a 100 kHz ac discharge has been constructed and investigated, and the experimental results obtained and a comparison with those of other lasers are presented.
a multibeam cw high-power CO2 laser has been built, with diffusive gas cooling, excited by a 1 MHz ac discharge.
a high-power, multibeam, CO2 laser was developed, which is excited by an ac glow discharge.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new type of cw CO2 laser with high-power output, high beam quality, and high reliability, and the laser described here is a first stage in this program.

the construction of a laser with the following characteristics: P ~ 1 kW; λ = 9.6 μm; divergence angle ~ 0.1°; beam diameter ~ 20 mm; beam power density in the focus > 100 kW/cm2; and efficiency ~ 5%.
the construction of a laser for the purpose of cutting metals and other materials.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the ac discharge CO2 laser is an efficient, reliable, and compact laser, which can be used for cutting, welding, and other applications.
the laser has a high efficiency of conversion of the electric power into the laser radiation energy and is characterized by high stability and reliability of operation.
the ac discharge CO2 laser is a promising and competitive alternative for the construction of high-power lasers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated that a multibeam CO laser with a discharge current frequency of 10 kHz is a powerful and reliable source of radiation.
we have developed a high-power multibeam laser with an output power of 1 kW and a beam diameter of 10 mm.
we have developed a new type of laser, which can be used in the fields of material processing and medicine.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of an ac discharge for exciting the gas mixture in a high-power CO2 laser is a promising method for increasing its efficiency.
the ac discharge is an effective way to excite a multibeam CO laser.
the use of an ac discharge as the pumping mechanism is very promising and can be used to construct high-power multibeam lasers.
